The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. I also added a line to the method's Javadoc saying cancelled orders are left out.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged. Nothing is committed.
